As a bonus action, you can channel your Force attunement for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits (and you may invoke a totem as part of the same bonus action):

  • Your carrying capacity and your push/drag/lift weight double — or triple if they're already doubled by another effect.
  • You gain advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
  • Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage.

This ends early if you're incapacitated or die. You have two uses of this feature, all restored on a long rest.
